page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6r.4xlarge is an ARM64-based server powered by a 16-core Ampere Altra processor running at 2.8 GHz. The instance features 16 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core allocation, meaning hyperthreading is disabled. It is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core, and operates on a KVM hypervisor. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average multi-core capabilities, with a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 28612.3 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 9534.0. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 1104.0 and a weak bzip3 single-threaded decompression rate of 8.6 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth is solid, reaching 1137.11 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 135.55 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. The server demonstrates average throughput for static web serving at 18.56 GB/sec and handles Redis SET operations at 22.17 million operations per second.

The instance presents clear tradeoffs, particularly in cryptographic and single-threaded tasks, with a weak PassMark CPU encryption test score of 2558.55. Additionally, while small-model LLM inference is average, prompt processing for medium 7B models is weak at 19.07 tokens per second. Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated physical cores, this server is designed for compute-optimized workloads such as software compilation, multi-threaded decompression, static web serving, and database operations that do not require local storage or high-performance single-core execution.
